scope: KGP continuous indexer PostgreSQL connection lifecycle and failure recovery

pytest.command: python3 -m pytest tests/test_kgp_worker_durability.py tests/test_guild_services.py tests/test_guild_reorg.py tests/test_kgp_service.py -q

verified: Each KGP scan cycle requests a fresh PostgreSQL connection with a five-second timeout.
A database failure followed by failed rollback and failed scan-status persistence does not stop the next cycle.
The configured worker identity is retained across connection retries.
Every scan cycle closes its connection and the durable database lease remains responsible for reclaim after expiry.
Nonfinite and nonpositive polling intervals are rejected before connection attempts.
limitations: Checks use fault-injected unit fixtures; no PostgreSQL or external RPC outage was exercised.
Live chain replay, lease expiry/reclaim, and long-duration provider recovery remain open.
Candidate and legacy databases were not accessed.
